slides.headline: A week for honest hearts and second drafts
Venus squares Pluto
slides.body: Love and pleasure meet something deeper. Old jealousies or big feelings can surface. Say the true thing, gently, and let the rest pass.

slides.headline: Scorpio season begins
slides.body: The Sun moves into Scorpio. The next month rewards depth over small talk, and letting go of what you've outgrown.

slides.headline: Mercury turns retrograde
slides.body: Three weeks of second thoughts begin. Back up your files, reread before you send, and give old ideas a second look.

slides.headline: The Sun meets Venus
slides.body: The heart of the sky lines up with the planet of love. A lovely moment to notice what, and who, you truly value.

slides.headline: Mercury seems to walk backwards
slides.body: It doesn't really. Earth is overtaking it, so from here it looks like it's reversing for about three weeks.

slides.headline: Words, plans and travel slow down
slides.body: Astrologers link it to crossed wires and second thoughts. It's less a curse and more a pause to review.

slides.headline: Re-do, re-read, reconnect
slides.body: Double-check messages and plans. Finish old projects. Reach out to someone from the past, if it feels right.

slides.headline: Panic
slides.body: Nothing has to go wrong. It's weather, not a verdict. Pack an umbrella and keep going.
